- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:~170+ | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The review-judge test checks static helper text but does not exercise the live Semble prefetch failure path.
  WHY: A broken wiring path could still pass this test because it never validates the runtime behavior of the direct `semble_query_block` call.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:209-269 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The new Semble query helper path lacks input validation around the JSON processing it feeds into `jq`.
  WHY: Malformed diagnostics or `PR_META` can crash the path and leave the judge without a fallback query file.
